ev.q: From 2000 to 2014, the percentage of newborns who had documented newborn hearing screening increased from 52% to >97%
just 4.6% of infants who did not pass newborn hearing screening in Massachusetts in 2014 were lost to follow-up/lost to documentation
EHDI is a mature point-of-care screening program that has demonstrated health and economic benefits.
CDC Grand Rounds: Newborn Screening for Hearing Loss and Critical Congenital Heart Disease
